email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with severe abdominal pain and vomiting
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 84-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 1 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-08-05.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
L. Petrov (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter794@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
